steps.name: Theo
steps.text: Wow. There are so many people here...

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: Sorry. Please make way—

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: —Aah!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: I've been to Millington Street already. It was picked clean ages ago! The shops are still open, but the shelves are all empty! Even the shopping bags are gone!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: Kraman said they had stuff left here, so I ran five blocks only to find not even a single fowlbeast feather left!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: Might as well go back, grab my crossbow, and sneak past the guards to hunt in the Dark Woods—at least I might get some real meat before I starve.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: You've really gone crazy from hunger now—going into the forest is a death wish!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: And you're not crazy? Stop talking like you know anything!

spans.text: crazy? Stop talking like you know anything!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Who are you to say I don't know anything? The grain store on Lagran Street, Emma's place, you know about it?

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: Haven't had a chance to check it out yet. What of it?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: I went there and had a look. There's no grain left, but from what Emma says, it's all because of those bloody Victorians!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: The Victorian bastards have been blockading us since forever. This isn't new, so why act like it's a big shock?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Because their spies have already infiltrated Na Saoirsí!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: Come again?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: When Emma went to visit the ag plate, she saw the charred remains with her own eyes. Dublinn is still investigating!

steps.name: Impatient Resident
steps.text: Bloody hell! We should've struck back the minute Tara gained independence!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: You're right about one thing though: you should go get your crossbow. Not to hunt, but to root out the traitors!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Of course, if I caught them, I wouldn't let them off that easy. A quick death is too good for them.

spans.text: caught them, I wouldn't let them off that easy. A quick death is too good for them.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) I guess the stores have been cut off from the supply of grain...

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) I boiled a few potatoes for Culann, but is it enough?

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) There are too many people here. I'll take another route.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) Lots of them are armed too...

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) Are they planning to hunt down Victorian spies? But there's no grain left in the city... what does that have to do with the Victorians?

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) But I....

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: (*Whispers*) I...

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: I'll be fine. I'm Mr. Culann's apprentice—everyone knows that.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: Don't be afraid, Theo. No one will hurt you.
Theo crouches down and squeezes through the crowd, making his way to the opposite corner of the street. He nimbly slips through a dark, narrow passage and emerges on the other side of a brick wall.
The noise of the crowd gradually fades from his ears.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: ....See? No one gave me any trouble.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: Mr. Culann must still be busy with the dragon sculpture. By the time he notices what's going on around him, all the stores will be empty.

steps.name: Theo
steps.text: I need to help him.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Take these and give them to the neighbors. Tell them not to worry.

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: What about you? Or Nemos? Will she have anything to eat?

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: Instead of giving us grain, it'd be more useful to help everyone catch the spies. Otherwise, we'll never get to the root of the problem.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: ...I'll go. Please let everyone know.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: But for now, just take them.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Nemos stands with The Leader, so it's only natural to endure a little hardship for everyone's sake.

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: ...Alright then. Thank you.

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Hey Culann, you must have more where that came from, right?

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Besides, how'd you know we'd be running out of grains? Did Nemos tip you off in advance, or...?

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: What are you saying, Rory?!

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: If you don't want any, fine.

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: How do I know you or Nemos aren't spies? You've both been raising that Victorian boy together!

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: ...Get out.

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: What, did I hit a nerve? Am I right? Are you really—

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Culann! I heard you've been distributing grain! Impeccable timing! So where is it?

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Everything that's left is right here.

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Don't change the subject. You still haven't answered me.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: I've said everything I had to say. If you feel these potatoes will dirty your hands, then give them to someone else.

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Do you want them or not, Rory? If not, then let me have them. There are plenty of hungry bellies to feed. Don't be ungrateful.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Now give them here—

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Why should I?

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: You don't want them, right? So give them to me!

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: Fat chance!

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Ugh—Aaahh!
The potatoes in the bag were very small. None had the usual oval shape.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: My arm!

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: My God! He's bleeding! How could you turn a blade on a fellow Taran, Rory?!

steps.name: Brooding Resident
steps.text: I, I—

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Drop the sword.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Don't make me use my hammer on you.

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: Y-You're the only one we can count on, Culann.

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: Something's been off about Rory lately, I'll follow him a bit, to check up on him. He's been out of sorts ever since his antique collection got burned in the war.

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: As for his blade, just take it. Don't let him have it back.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Culann... I... Ughh...

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: The wound isn't too deep. Come here, I'll stop the bleeding. As far as the grains, I'll have Nemos think of a solution when she gets back.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: I know... ow ow ow... I know. You're giving away everything you have.

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: But you know, you're not as scary as you look—

steps.name: Anxious Resident
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Don't talk. Save your energy.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: I might have some cornmeal left at home. Let me check.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: You can have it, then I'll walk you home.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Culann! Are you and Theo doing alright—

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: ...Why is there blood in here?

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Rory lost control and slashed someone.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Where's Theo?

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: He left a while ago for—

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: *Sigh* Forget it. No one could have foreseen things getting so bad, so quickly.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: How are things in the city?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Rumors are spreading everywhere that the Victorians destroyed the ag plate, and Na Saoirsí is about to boil over.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: I know no one dared to go after Theo after you stood up for him, so you felt safe letting him run around. But this time... it's different.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: I have to go find him.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Do you have time for that? Aren't you making that statue?

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: It only needs to be finished before Samhain. There's still a little time left...

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Dammit! Dammit!

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: I'll worry about Theo. You just focus on your work.

steps.name: Culann
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Have you seen Theo?

steps.name: Friendly Resident
steps.text: Theo? Where has that boy run off to... Slacking off again, no doubt. Culann spoils him too much. You really should talk to him about that.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Theo, Theo!

steps.name: Indifferent Resident
steps.text: What trouble has that boy gotten himself into this time?

spans.text: What trouble has that boy gotten himself into

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Have you seen Theo?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Silent Resident
steps.text: ...Me? Yeah, I'm fine. Just... hungry. So what is it? Did you say something?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Just the person I was looking for! Has that boy Theo been up to anything suspicious lately?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: ...No. Just keeping himself busy, as usual.

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Hmph, well he'd better.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Theo!
What are you doing here, Wakewoman?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Wait, you're—oh, 'The Singer'. What brings you here?

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: I heard rumors of chaos in the city, so I thought there might be something I could do to help. Alas, there is not. All I've heard is that the supply shortage was caused by Victorian sabotage.

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: I've only ever run into the Victorian army by accident, and you and Culann were the ones to save me at the time.

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: Also, the information you've provided us on the wakemen has been truly fascinating—

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Ah, sorry sir, but I really don't have time to be reminiscing. But I could use your assistance. Culann's apprentice, Theo, has gone missing. Can you help me look for him?

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: I am... unable to help with that.

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: The cityfolk are angry enough at the Victorians to flay one alive. Why bother running around looking for a Victorian child?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Forget it then. I'll go look myself.

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: Remember that the celebration will start in just over an hour. Don't you need to deliver the sacred instruments symbolizing the wakemen's blessings to the venue?

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: 'The Singer'
steps.text: *Sigh* Sorry, I really must be going now.

steps.name: Nemos
steps.text: What do I do now...?

steps.name: Loughshinny
steps.text: Nemos? Is that you?

steps.name: Loughshinny
steps.text: I've finally found you. What happened in the city?
